en: The East Frostwolf Tower was taken by the Horde!
You are talking nonsense, mage.
I require a teleport to Naxxramas.
%s wipes his brow.
I don't suppose you're here to talk about my lovely Kali. Fine, then. Potions it is. Anyone ever tell ye you've got a one-track mind?

I highly recommend that you visit Sayge to get your fortune told. I know, I know... he's a gnoll.  But he's a very special gnoll with the power to divine your future!$B$BAnd we are constantly expanding the faire with all manner of new attractions!
Your world shall suffer an unmerciful end. The Nightmare comes for you!
This collection of scrolls contains various logistic and strategic information, as well as coded correspondences.
First Aid
What goods have I earned the right to purchase for use in Warsong Gulch?
WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
Rin'ji can see the road now, $n. Rin'ji knows the way home.
Hm... I don't think this blinking red light is a good thing...
Don't get too close, $n. I'm liable to fumble and bash your brains open with the face of my hammer.
Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
Ah yes. I've heard all about those new flarged things. Armor was removed from the casing to decrease weight. Bargh! Nonsense!

When facing a spellcaster of any kind, this feral beast will be your best friend. Now, let us take a look at something a bit different. This next creature will aid your travels and make your future journeys much easier. Let's take a look at a felsteed.
I'm going to make a fortune with these horns, $n.  Thanks!
I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!
Step carefully mortal.  You tread where mightier beings have met their fate.
Seek out Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise.

I fear for the worst, old friend. Within the Dream we fight a new foe, born of an ancient evil. Ysera's noble brood has fallen victim to the old whisperings. It seems as if the Nightmare has broken through the realm and seeks a new host on Azeroth.
This cultist is in a deep trance...
Be on the alert! The Blackwood furbolgs are numerous in this area...
Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Tailor here in Stormwind. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?
Return the amulet! Return to me what was stolen!!
Good day, $glad:lass;! Perhaps you could help me with some things that need to be taken care of.
Huh?!?  Oh.  You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch.  Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?
%s chugs his drink.

Captain Galvangar is the trusted aid to Drek'Thar.  He leads the Horde forces from the Iceblood Garrison, in the southern section of the the Field of Strife.$B$BCaptain Galvangar has not yet entered the battle.

Hmmm, I think you will need to go up to Thunder Bluff to learn that.  Head north on the road out of Bloodhoof Village.  It will take you to the base of Thunder Bluff.  Ride the elevator to the top and you should be able to ask any of the Bluffwatchers there for further assistance.

Hendel is in our custody now, $n, thanks to you.$B$BAlthough the questioning goes slowly, I assure you, he will tell us everything he knows.$B$BFor now, please be patient. I will contact you immediately if we have need of your assistance.$B$BUntil then, please, enjoy Theramore and I invite you to stay for as long as you like within our city's walls as a friend of the Alliance.
%s, too injured, gives up the chase.
$n, unlocking the secret of these collars is beyond my skills...
Purged by pain!
Thanks, Ragged John. Your story was very uplifting and informative.
Hah! Serves you right, you filthy trogg!!
We're not really rude people, stranger, it's just that everyone is in a rush, trying to make sure that everything is perfect for Uther's arrival. It's not often that the Lightbringer comes to town.
I heard all the kobolds that were down there are dead.
Sure, sure.  We have a Mining Trainer right here in town.  Look for Krunn over in the northwest corner alongside the inn.
I am not worthy, sir.
Hear ye, denizens of Tanaris! Let it be known that $n is an exalted member of the Mithril Order. A blacksmith of honor, dedication, and infinite patience. Three cheers for $n!
Brash. Master Ravenholdt does not like brash.
